{{Top|leg}}
A '''disrupting emitter''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] emitter that created an unsteady beam that was capable of wreaking havoc on a victim's [[nervous system]]. However, the wielder of the blade would have had more difficultly in dodging an enemy's blows.
